Questions, answered

Good to know.

How do I book a subscription?

Tap any plan button or WhatsApp us at 8796821205. Share your society name, car model and preferred plan so we can confirm availability.

Do you use a separate cloth for each car?

Yes. Karawsh's plan includes dedicated microfibre cloths for every car, with no reuse between cars.

What is included in weekly interior cleaning?

Interior cleaning covers the dashboard, door panels, centre console and mats. Vacuuming and polishing frequency depends on the plan selected.

Is service available in my society?

Availability depends on the society and operational coverage. Message us on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you subscribe.

Are the listed prices monthly?

Yes, the displayed Lite, Plus and Premium prices are monthly subscription prices. Confirm vehicle eligibility and any applicable terms with Karawsh before booking.
